tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on cream (14.7:1) and bone (12.1:1); the ground of every .dark section.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Footer ground (.charcoal) only. cream text on it is 13.1:1.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The sage page ground and .cream sections; the text colour on ink (14.7:1) and charcoal (13.1:1). Was #f4efe6 before the sage shift.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Alternate light band (.bone, the services grid) and the image-placeholder fill. ink on it 12.1:1, ink-muted 5.7:1.

tokens.name: taupe
tokens.usage: Labels: light-ground eyebrows, attributions, captions, aside notes, footer fine print. Reads on ink (6.9:1) and charcoal (6.2:1). FAILS on cream (2.1:1) and bone (1.75:1), where the site uses it for 11px eyebrows; kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The accent, used as a line: eyebrow dashes, CTA underline, process line, nav hover underline; and numerals 01–04. On ink 6.7:1. As text on cream 2.2:1 and bone 1.8:1, below 3:1 even for the 48–54px numerals; kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: The accent on dark grounds: .dark eyebrows, result figures, CTA and footer-link hovers, the on-dark logomark. On ink 10.2:1, charcoal 9.1:1. Never on a light ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on cream (6.95:1) and bone (5.7:1): section intros, item descriptions, process and manifesto copy.

tokens.name: on-dark-82
tokens.usage: Long-form copy on ink: philosophy paragraphs, service-block pairs, founder note on dark. 11.4:1 on ink. A tint of #f4efe6, the pre-sage cream the palette shift did not update.

tokens.name: on-dark-78
tokens.usage: Standard paragraph text on ink and charcoal: hero, results, final CTA, page-hero on dark, footer links. 10.4:1 on ink, 9.5:1 on charcoal. Pre-sage cream tint.

tokens.name: on-dark-72
tokens.usage: One-paragraph intros on ink: reframe and results head. 8.9:1 on ink. Pre-sage cream tint.

tokens.name: on-dark-60
tokens.usage: The footer brand blurb on charcoal, 6.2:1. Quietest legible text on dark. Pre-sage cream tint.

tokens.name: taupe-35

tokens.name: veil-dark

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section ground. data-theme="dark" on a container is the token form of the site's .dark class.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: The alternate band: bone between cream sections, charcoal for the footer.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The opposite tone of the current ground, for a band or block that must contrast with surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface and surface-alt: 14.7:1 / 12.1:1 light, 14.7:1 / 13.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary paragraphs on surface and surface-alt: 6.95:1 / 5.7:1 light, 10.4:1 / 9.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Eyebrow and small-label text. Dark 10.2:1 on surface. Light FAILS: taupe on cream 2.1:1, as in the source; flagged.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent lines and numerals: the eyebrow dash, rules, 01–04. A line or a figure, never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between items and above the footer.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Playfair Display 400 for every heading, never bold; italic is the only emphasis. Sizes are the desktop end of each fluid clamp().
